usersInfo.title: Users info pattern
usersInfo.overviewText1: Yeh Page ek haqeeqi par mabni users ki fehrist ka demo/show karta hai: server pre fetched re act query data, nuqs chalaya gaya U R L state (Talash, Tarteeb, Page, Page ka size), ek shadcn/ui data table, aur ek permanent server + client hydration pattern.
usersInfo.overviewText2: Server pre fetch loader ke andar chalta hai aur QueryClient Cash ko hydrate karta hai. client par, useSuspenseQuery pehle render par dobara hasil kiye baghair Cash se parhta hai. agar user door jaata hai aur wapas aata hai to, staleTime Cash ko taza rakhta hai.
usersInfo.overviewText3: Nuqs parsers query parameters chalate hain: Talash ke liye `q`, Tarteeb dene ke liye `sort` / `dir`, pagination ke liye `page` / `pageSize`. query state aur server state alag alag rehte hain — U R L mein Edit hamesha data ko up date karti hai kyun ke hook ko single truth ke zariye ke taur par istemal kya jaata hai.
usersInfo.overviewText4: TanStack table server side Tarteeb diya gaya hai: `manualSorting`, `manualPagination`, aur server se rows ki tadad. columns `formatLabel()` helper ka dobara istemal karte hain taakay enum values poori app mein permanent rahein.
usersInfo.overviewText5: Yahan sab kuch dobara istemal ke qabil hai: `users/_components` folder copy karein, API calls ko Badlein, aur aap ko chand minutes mein ek naya paginated, Tarteeb dene ke qabil, qabil Talash table mil jaye ga.
usersInfo.serverPrefetchText: Page loader ke andar hum client par istemal hone wali ek hi query key ke sath `queryClient.prefetchInfiniteQuery` (ya `prefetchQuery`) call karte hain. hydrate shuda Cash ko `<Hydrate>` ke taur par serialize kya jaata hai aur client par `<HydrateOnClient>` ke sath dobara hydrate kya jaata hai.
usersInfo.urlStateTitle: Nuqs ke sath U R L state
usersInfo.urlStateText: Table ke tamam controls U R L mein rehte hain: `?q=&sort=name&dir=asc&page=1&pageSize=10`. search box mein type karne se U R L up date hota hai; U R L up date karne se query up date hoti hai. book marks aur back/forward box se kaam karte hain.
usersInfo.patternComparison: Products server side rendering se data le kar table ko dete hain. users server pre fetch aur client hydration istemal karte hain, jis se pas view mein dobara data lena, shared Cash aur fori up dates bhi mumkin hoti hain.
usersInfo.patternText1: 1. ek query key factory specified karein (maslan `usersKeys`) taakay server aur client ek hi key shape ka ishtirak karein.
usersInfo.patternText2: 2. apne loader mein, `queryClient.prefetchQuery(usersKeys.list({ ... }))` ke sath pre fetch karein aur D hydrate karein.
usersInfo.patternText3: 3. client par, isi un put ke sath `useSuspenseQuery(usersKeys.list({ ... }))` call karein — Cash shuda data foran istemal hota hai.
usersInfo.nuqsDocs: Nuqs U R L state documents

reactQueryInfo.title: React Query pattern
reactQueryInfo.serverPrefetchText: Data server par getQueryClient().prefetchQuery() ke zariye pehle se hasil kya jaata hai. D hydrate shuda state HydrationBoundary ko di jaati hai taakay client pehle se Cash shuda data ke sath shuru ho aur pehli baar loading spinner se bacha ja sake.
reactQueryInfo.queryOptionsText: Query keys aur data hasil karne wale function shared queryOptions() object mein specified hote hain. ise server pre fetch aur client hooks mein dobara istemal karne se donon hum aahang rehte hain.
reactQueryInfo.suspenseText: Client useSuspenseQuery() istemal karta hai, jo React Suspense ke sath kaam karta hai. server pre fetch ke sath data foran dastiyab hota hai; baad ki navigation par Cash purana hone ki soorat mein suspense fall back dikhata hai.
reactQueryInfo.optimisticText: Request mukammal hone se pehle tabdeeliyan Cash ko fori taur par up date kar sakti hain. request nakam ho to pichli Condition restore hoti hai; mukammal hone par taza data lene ke liye query ko dobara chalaya jaata hai.
